lead: Every planet ever confirmed around another star, on one chart. Click a dot to meet that world, watch it pass in front of its star, and see how long a trip there would take.
try: Type TRAPPIST-1 in the search box at the top and click one of its planets. Then scroll to Watch it transit to see it cross in front of its star.
points: Telescopes find most of these planets by spotting the tiny dip in starlight when a planet passes in front of its star.
A small planet around a tiny star blocks much more light than Earth blocks of the Sun.
A planet that is Earth-sized and gets Earth-like sunlight is only a first guess. It does not mean the planet has life, or even water.
